summary.text: Justin Pak is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 157, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Melissa Shusterman.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father, a lifelong Pennsylvanian and a former teacher.

paragraphs.text: Justin Pak earned a bachelor's degree from West Chester University and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey response, he described himself as a concerned father, a lifelong Pennsylvanian and a first-generation Korean American.
He wrote that he is a former teacher and called for reinvesting in schools, including more pen-and-paper and hands-on instruction.
Pak also listed oversight of data-center energy demand and of PJM, the regional grid operator, among his campaign messages, along with safe communities, affordable energy and lower taxes.
